source='''def transform(grid):
    """Move the colored object flush against the straight color-2 wall.

    Draw a full color-8 line immediately behind the relocated object, on the
    side away from the wall.
    """
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    wall = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    if not wall:
        return out
    wall_rows = {r for r, c in wall}
    wall_cols = {c for r, c in wall}
    horizontal = len(wall_rows) == 1 and len(wall) == w
    vertical = len(wall_cols) == 1 and len(wall) == h
    if not (horizontal or vertical):
        return out
    colors = [v for row in grid for v in row if v != 2]
    bg = max(set(colors), key=colors.count)
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
           if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 2)]
    if not pts:
        return out
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
    color = grid[pts[0][0]][pts[0][1]]
    dr = dc = 0
    if vertical:
        wc = next(iter(wall_cols))
        if c1 < wc:
            dc = wc - 1 - c1
            marker = c0 + dc - 1
        else:
            dc = wc + 1 - c0
            marker = c1 + dc + 1
    else:
        wr = next(iter(wall_rows))
        if r1 < wr:
            dr = wr - 1 - r1
            marker = r0 + dr - 1
        else:
            dr = wr + 1 - r0
            marker = r1 + dr + 1
    for r, c in pts:
        out[r][c] = bg
    moved = [(r + dr, c + dc) for r, c in pts]
    for r, c in moved:
        out[r][c] = color
    if vertical:
        for r in range(h):
            if grid[r][marker] != 2:
                out[r][marker] = 8
    else:
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[marker][c] != 2:
                out[marker][c] = 8
    return out
'''
